title: A core's status change writes its own Part History entry
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [Part-A] = tracked part with a Core Charge, so it has a core [Core-A] ("Core for [Desc-A]").
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL COREHIST PART), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-COREHIST-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00), Core Charge (e.g. $25.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  2. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-COREHIST-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL COREHIST PART).
  3. Check the setup worked: on the Active tab search "Core for [Desc-A]": [Core-A] is listed with a clock icon. If core rows are not listed, the core's Part History cannot be opened by hand: write 'not checked by hand' and stop.
custom_steps:
1. On the Active tab search [Part-A], click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save, type the note "ZZAUTOTEST core follows" and click "Deactivate" in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  2. On the Inactive tab search "Core for [Desc-A]" and click its clock icon ("Part History").
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: [Part-A] moves to the Inactive tab and so does [Core-A].
  • Step 2: [Core-A]'s Part History has its own newest entry "Deactivated | Reason: ZZAUTOTEST core follows".
